subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt/rework the open fork PR or close/supersede it and allow a narrow replacement fix for this cron stagger bug?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but an open closing fork PR exists and is not maintainer-editable, so ClawSweeper should not start a competing repair lane until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace the uneditable fork PR
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and queue a narrow maintainer-owned replacement that preserves contributor credit and covers the shared runtime/doctor paths.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR manually
options.body: Ask the fork author to update the branch or manually port its useful changes, then review it against current Croner-compatible semantics.

options.title: Pause for product scope
options.body: Keep the issue open without repair until maintainers decide whether the default stagger should also cover wildcard or fixed-hour cases.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable fork PR
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and queue a narrow maintainer-owned replacement that preserves contributor credit and covers the shared runtime/doctor paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the original default-stagger helper and cron service integration history.
